args.reason: Discrepancy on supplier payment TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to Chidi's Farm Produce, Access Bank 0234567891, invoice INV-88). Our Ledgerline dashboard shows the transfer as failed, but the recipient bank's final status confirms the money WAS credited to the account on 2026-11-21 at 14:02 UTC (session ID 000014261121140211000088). The supplier says he has not received the funds and is requesting a resend. Resending now risks a double payment of ₦250,000. Needs a human to reconcile the failed status with Ledgerline and advise whether to resend or ask the supplier to check with Access Bank using the session ID.
